nodes.label: Caveman Communication Mode
nodes.rationale: Terse caveman-style responses cut token fluff (articles, filler, pleasantries, hedging) while preserving all technical substance; code, commits, and PRs stay in normal prose. Intensity switchable via /caveman lite|full|ultra|wenyan.

nodes.label: Auto-Clarity Rule
nodes.rationale: Safety valve on caveman mode: drop compressed style for security warnings, irreversible actions, or user confusion, then resume — clarity outranks token savings when stakes are high.
